sn12.17:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || ||
sn12.17:1.3: I 2 Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagaham piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3
sn12.17:1.4: Addasā kho Acela-Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantam || ||
sn12.17:1.5: Disvāna yena Bhagava tenupasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.17:1.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || 4 Ekam antam ṭhito kho Acela-Kassapo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.17:1.7: Puccheyyāma mayaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ kiñcid eva desaṃ || sa ce no bhavaṃ Gotamo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti || ||
sn12.17:2.1: Dutiyam pi kho Acela-Kassapo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.17:2.2: Puccheyyāma mayam bhavantam Gotamaṃ kiñcid eva desaṃ || sa ce no bhavan Gotamo okāsam karoti pañhāssa veyyākaraṇāyāti || ||
sn12.17:2.7: Evam vutte Acela-Kassapo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.17:2.8: Na kho pana mayam bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ bahudeva pucchitukāmāti || ||
sn12.17:3.1: Kim nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn12.17:3.3: Kim pana bho Gotama paraṃkataṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn12.17:3.5: Kim nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca dukkhanti || ||
sn12.17:3.7: Kim pana bho Gotama asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃkāram adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn12.17:3.9: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama natthi dukkhanti ||
sn12.17:3.12: Tena hi bhavaṃ Gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti ||
sn12.17:3.13: Na khvāhaṃ Kassapa dukkham na jānāmi na passāmi ||
sn12.17:4.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃkatam dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevaṃ Kassapā ti vadesi || ||
sn12.17:4.2: Kiṃ pana bho Gotama paraṃ-kataṃ dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevaṃ Kassapā ti vadesi || ||
sn12.17:4.3: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sayaṃ-katañ ca paraṃ-katañ ca dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Mā hevaṃ Kassapāti vadesi || ||
sn12.17:4.4: Kim pana bho Gotama asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Māhevam Kassapāti vadesi ||
sn12.17:4.5: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama natthi dukkhanti iti puṭṭho samāno Na kho Kassapa natthi dukkham atthi kho Kassapa dukkhanti vadesi || ||
sn12.17:4.6: Tena hi bhavaṃ Gotamo dukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāhaṃ Kassapa dukkham na jānāmi na passāmi ||
sn12.17:4.8: passāmi khvāhaṃ Kassapa dukkhan ti vadesi ||
sn12.17:4.9: ācikkhatu ca me bhante Bhagavā dukkhaṃ
sn12.17:4.10: desetu ca me bhante Bhagavā dukkhan ti || || 14
sn12.17:5.1: So karoti so paṭisaṃvediyatīti kho Kassapa ādito sato sayaṃkataṃ dukkhanti iti vadaṃ sassatam etam pareti ||
sn12.17:5.2: Añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvediyatīti kho Kassapa vedanābhitunnassa sato paraṃkataṃ dukkhanti iti vadam ucchedam etam pareti || || 15
sn12.17:5.3: Ete te Kassapa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammam deseti || ||
sn12.17:5.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.17:5.9: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || 16
sn12.17:6.1: Evam vutte Acela-Kassapo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.17:6.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya || pe|| cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti || Evam evaṃ Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn12.17:6.4: Esāham bhante Bhagavantam saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca ||
sn12.17:6.5: labheyyāham bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjam labheyyam upasampadanti || || 17
sn12.17:7.1: Yo kho Kassapa aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjam ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ || so cattāro māse parivasati || Catunnaṃ māsānam accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsaṃ āraddhacittā bhikkhū ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya || ||
sn12.17:7.2: Api ca mayā (alias mettha, C) puggalavemattatā viditāti || || 18
sn12.17:8.1: Sa ce bhante aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjam ākaṅkhati upasampadam cattāro māse parivasati || catunnam māsānam accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsam āraddhacittā bhikkhū ākaṅkhamānā pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya || ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi catunnaṃ vassānam accayena parivuṭṭhaparivāsam āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti || || 19
sn12.17:9.1: Alattha kho Acela-Kassapo Bhagavato santike pabbajjam alattha upasampadaṃ || || 20
sn12.17:9.2: Acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā Kassapo eko vupakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariya-pariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi ||
sn12.17:9.3: khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || 21
sn12.17:9.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Kassapo arahatam ahosīti || ||
